crossRefs.note: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
“Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean…
Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t…
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we…
For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like…
Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have…
When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
“Look, Yahweh; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously…
Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.

translations.web: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
translations.bsb: If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.
translations.kjv: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
translations.asv: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head; Being filled with ignominy, And looking upon mine affliction.
